answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 62 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in cedar, queued in ember, and whisper publishes the wait time. A farm of 282 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 972 identities would post 4097 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
